blocks.text: 🪝 West Bengal Launches 'PMCSPY' ₹313.30 Crore Special Package for Tea Garden Workers. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Allocates ₹177 crore for Cha Shramik Shiksha and constructs 321 modern resting sheds.
Package Outlay: ₹313.30 crore special assistance package under Pradhan Mantri Cha Shramik Protsahan Yojana.
Three Pillars: Cha Shramik Shiksha Yojana (₹177 cr), Swasthya Suraksha (₹72 cr), and Aashray Yojana (₹63 cr for 321 resting sheds).
Education allocation (₹177 cr) vs healthcare (₹72 cr) vs resting sheds (₹63 cr).
